info.title: HKChecker
info.author: gasu95
info.details:
HKChecker is an offline Hollow Knight save completion analyzer for Nintendo Switch that tracks your progress toward 112%.

Features:
- Reads save slots directly from Switch internal storage (user1.dat - user4.dat) or SD card backups (e.g., sdmc:/JKSV/).
- 8 complete tabs: MAIN, ESSENTIALS, JOURNAL, COLLECTIBLES, GEO CACHES, SECRETS, GODMASTER, and STATISTICS (~400 items).
- Built-in anti-spoiler system: hides uncollected items and locations by default (reveal individually with A/touch or toggle all with Y).
- Filter missing items with X.
- Bilingual UI (English / Spanish) with instant switching via [-] and automatic system language detection.
- Full button, analog stick, and touch screen support.

Note: Launch via Title Override (hold [R] while launching any game) to read internal Switch save data.


AI use: Co-written with AI.

changelog: Initial release v1.0.0 with full 112% completion database, internal Switch save mounting, anti-spoiler mode, and English/Spanish UI.
